messages:
Ivy (Recruiter): Diego accepted offer for 2026-04-08 start. He just messaged that his EAD renewal is pending and asked whether Redwood will cover premium processing if it speeds things up. Also asked about vesting start if paid start changes.
Priya - People Ops: Policy recap: we consider reimbursement for premium processing in exceptional cases. Candidate pays upfront and submits receipts; People Ops + Finance will evaluate per policy. Need Legal sign-off on immigration reimbursements too.
Marcus (Payroll): Payroll note: even with premium processing, we need the physical EAD or acceptable List A doc before running his first paid cycle. If EAD arrives mid-cycle and docs are uploaded before payroll cutoff (4/18 EOD), we can retro-pay to the paid start date.
Comp-Team: For equity, there are two options: keep original hire date for vesting schedule while delaying payroll (requires approval), or tie vesting to actual paid start date. Which does Diego prefer? We'll need manager + Comp sign-off for making the hire date exception.
Diego R (New Hire): Hi everyone  I would prefer to keep the original hire date for vesting if possible. I'm open to paying for premium and then submitting receipt if you all approve reimbursement. Also I can do orientation-only starting 4/8 if needed.
Legal-Team: We can approve reimbursement clauses with controls (cap amount, receipts, timeline). We'll draft language: reimbursement only if premium processing results in approval within X days and receipts provided; Redwood reserves right to decline if not eligible. Also include tax treatment note (reimbursement may be taxable).
Priya - People Ops: Sounds good. Action items: 1) Diego upload I-797C receipt and passport/EAD scans; 2) Ivy loop Legal and Comp for the reimbursement + vesting exception; 3) Marcus flag payroll for potential retro-pay; 4) People Ops will draft contingent addendum with premium reimbursement clause.
Ivy (Recruiter): Diego uploaded the I-797C and passport scans.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Diego R: i797c_apr_upload.pdf (HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Marcus (Payroll): Noted. If Diego opts for premium processing and we reimburse, payroll needs receipts and the amount will be handled via expense policy (or payroll as taxable reimbursement) per Legal/Finance guidance. We'll coordinate with Finance.
Comp-Team: We'll evaluate the hire-date exception and post decision here. Manager okayed vesting being preserved pending Comp approval.
Diego R (New Hire): Thanks  I'll keep receipts and wait for the addendum. Quick Q: if we do orientation-only 4/8-4/14, will benefits be delayed?
Priya - People Ops: Benefits activation ties to paid employment date. If we retro-pay once EAD arrives before benefits cutoff, we can backdate coverage; otherwise effective date will be when payroll and benefits are activated. We'll include this in the addendum.
Legal-Team: Draft clause posted (summary): "Company may reimburse premium processing fees up to $X upon presentation of valid receipts and proof that premium processing materially expedited adjudication. Reimbursements are subject to approval and may be taxable. Company reserves right to deny ineligible requests." We'll attach full legal text to the offer addendum.
Ivy (Recruiter): Sending addendum to Diego now for signature.
people-ops-bot: Reminder created: "Check Diego EAD/premium receipts" on 2026-04-10 09:00
Priya - People Ops: Thanks team. Once signed, we'll finalize whether paid start remains 4/8 (contingent) or shifts. Alex the manager will confirm orientation plan.
Diego R (New Hire): Signed the addendum. Appreciate the clear options. I'll update if I file premium.
Priya - People Ops: Closing: if EAD arrives before payroll cutoff and docs uploaded, payroll will retro-pay; if not, paid start becomes clearance date. Comp will confirm hire-date exception within 48 hours. :thumbsup:
